name: missing-directory with explicit clarification (everything else as case 1)
requirement:
Author's description of the change: "play button: cd into the workspace before running the command"
Author's comment in the change: "Prefix a cd into the workspace so the command always runs in the correct directory."
Author's clarification: "If the workspace cannot be entered, do not execute the command in another directory; report the failure."
alleged:
frontend/dist/app.js:9 — `cd <path> && <command>` silently aborts the command when the workspace directory is missing or stale, where the old code ran it unconditionally; depends on `workspace()` never returning a non-existent path, which I could not read.
When workspace() returns a path to a non-existent directory, `cd "<path>" && <command>` causes cd to fail, && short-circuits, and the command never runs — a regression from the pre-change behavior which ran the command unconditionally without a cd prefix.
remedy: Validate the path before prefixing (e.g. check existence), or switch to `cd ... ; <command>` to preserve unconditional execution (dropping the working-directory guarantee when cd fails), or confirm workspace() never returns a non-existent path and document the assumption.
records:
--- CHANGED CODE, input: workspace path /bad/missing/path (does not exist), command `echo COMMAND_RAN`
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): cd "/bad/missing/path" && echo COMMAND_RAN
setup before it: mkdir -p '/tmp/ws back'
exit code: 2
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: ''
stderr: "/tmp/__kai_run.sh: cd: line 1: can't cd to /bad/missing/path: No such file or directory\n"
--- PRE-CHANGE CODE (`Panels.select("terminal", { command })`), same input
generated command (executed verbatim by sh): echo COMMAND_RAN
setup before it: (none)
exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: 'COMMAND_RAN\n'
stderr: ''
--- PROPOSED REMEDY alternative `cd ... ; <command>`, same input

exit code: 0
working directory after the command: /tmp
stdout: 'COMMAND_RAN\n'
